text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While carrying out 
Program Rehearsal for the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
What a wondrous performance. 
Fufu... shall you conduct this rehearsal 
once more?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Asked by her, I pause to think. 
Considering the time and <chrname>'s condition, 
we could probably manage one more extra 
session, but...
choice_data_list:
Yes, I think I'll suggest an extra 
rehearsal.
...No, let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... 
Then may I also gaze upon 
Lady <chrname>'s devoted efforts?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After getting confirmation from <chrname>, 
I joined Azuma-san in cheering on 
her spirited efforts.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that too is a wise choice. 
Lady <chrname>'s well-being 
must ever remain the foremost priority.
